summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Alterity Therapeutics Limited, a foreign private issuer, providing a notification regarding unquoted securities (Exhibit 99.1). The filing does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. It is an ordinary periodic report incorporating exhibits by reference into existing registration statements.
